title: Team knowledge base with live sync
scenario: Conflicting requirements: 'no paid hosting' cannot hold together with 'always-on multi-user sync'. The conflict must be flagged, not silently resolved.
idea: A wiki for my 12 person team. Everyone edits at the same time and sees changes instantly, from anywhere. We don't want to pay for any hosting.

brief.problem: A small team needs one shared place for documentation that everyone can edit together.
brief.users: A team of 12, working from different places.

must_have.text: Several people can edit the same page at the same time
Changes appear for everyone within seconds, from any network

unknowns: Whether the team already runs a server that is always on

conflicts.description: An always-on service reachable from any network (REQ-2) needs a server that is always running, which conflicts with the 'No paid hosting' budget constraint unless the team already owns such a server.
